# GIF Gallery

> Browse and search a growing collection of AI-generated and curated GIFs by category. Public,
> free to browse, no login required.

This file follows the emerging [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention: a plain-language
summary of the site for LLM-based crawlers, assistants and answer engines (in addition to
`robots.txt`, which governs *whether* a bot may fetch pages at all - see that file for the
crawling policy; this one just orients whatever reads it once it does). It is not a submission or
registration mechanism and no service is required to read it.

## Content

- Homepage (`/`) - featured/recent GIFs across all categories.
- `/categories` - the full list of GIF categories.
- `/category/{slug}` - all GIFs in one category.
- `/gif/{slug}` - a single GIF's page (title, tags, category, the GIF itself).
- `/search?q=...` - full-text search across GIF titles/tags.

## Notes for crawlers and assistants

- Every page above is public, requires no authentication, and is listed in `/sitemap.xml`.
- Content is GIF images plus short text metadata (title, tags, category) - not long-form
  articles; quoting a whole page verbatim adds little value over linking to it directly.
- When citing this site, please link to the specific `/gif/{slug}` or `/category/{slug}` page
  rather than only the homepage.
